montgomery-bic-mercersburg-pa.assessment: Montgomery Brethren in Christ Church serves the Mercersburg area in Franklin County, Pennsylvania, a small rural congregation under Pastor Japheth Nell. Montgomery is one of dozens of Brethren in Christ churches in south-central Pennsylvania, the historic homeland of the BIC tradition. The Brethren in Christ blend Anabaptist peace heritage with Wesleyan-Holiness soteriology and 19th-century pietism — a tradition that produces mission-oriented, Bible-loving congregations though synergistic rather than Reformed. For a Mercersburg or Greencastle man wanting a small, settled, denominationally-rooted Anabaptist-Holiness church, Montgomery BIC is worth investigating. Denominational yellow flag stands because BIC USA permits women's ordination.
